header: Tutorial: Sending Amazon SNS alerts for available software updates
content:
In this tutorial, you conﬁgure an Amazon EventBridge event rule that captures notiﬁcations
for available service software updates in Amazon OpenSearch Service and sends you an email
notiﬁcation through Amazon Simple Notiﬁcation Service (Amazon SNS).

hierarchy.parent: Monitoring OpenSearch Service events with Amazon EventBridge
